movie.title: Crimson Shadows
movie.overview: With the Blood Moon hanging overhead and the Ghost Festival approaching, An Yunman suddenly returns from Shanghai to the An family residence in Xiwutong, western Hunan. Unexpectedly, her eldest and second brothers are murdered one after another by corpse-demons. Their father, An Bo, blames all the family's misfortunes on his third daughter, An Yunman, whom he believes to be a cursed bringer of disaster.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Upon returning to her ancestral home in western Hunan during the Ghost Festival, An Yunman is scapegoated by her grief-stricken father after her brothers fall victim to mysterious corpse-demons.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: As the Ghost Festival approaches under an ominous Blood Moon, An Yunman returns from Shanghai to her family's estate in Xiwutong, western Hunan. Her homecoming turns nightmare when her eldest and second brothers are brutally murdered in succession by sinister corpse-demons. Refusing to see the true supernatural threat, her father, An Bo, accuses Yunman of being a cursed harbinger of misfortune. Isolated and blamed, Yunman must confront both horrific supernatural entities and her family's hostility to uncover the truth.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Set against the eerie backdrop of western Hunan during the Ghost Festival, Crimson Shadows follows An Yunman as she returns home from Shanghai under a crimson Blood Moon. Her arrival at the An family residence in Xiwutong coincides with immediate, terrifying supernatural calamity. Shortly after her return, her eldest brother is viciously attacked and killed by a corpse-demon, sending shockwaves through the household. Before anyone can process the horror, her second brother meets a similar gruesome fate at the hands of the monstrous entity. Paralyzed by grief and ancient superstition, the patriarch An Bo refuses to seek logical answers and instead directs his fury inward at his third daughter. He convincedly accuses Yunman of being a cursed bringer of disaster whose presence invited dark spirits to destroy their lineage. With her father turning the entire household against her, Yunman finds herself completely isolated amidst rising peril. As corpse-demons continue to stalk the shadows, Yunman must race against time to defend herself, unravel family secrets, and expose the genuine source of the curse before it consumes everyone.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Crimson Shadows fuses folk horror, supernatural fantasy, and family drama against the haunting backdrop of western Hunan during the Ghost Festival. When An Yunman arrives from Shanghai at the family estate in Xiwutong beneath a Blood Moon, her return is instantly marred by tragedy as her two older brothers fall victim to murderous corpse-demons. Rather than uniting against the monstrous threat, her patriarch father, An Bo, blames Yunman as a cursed presence responsible for the catastrophe. Trapped between terrifying supernatural predators and relentless familial resentment, Yunman must navigate dark mysteries and ancient superstitions to discover the evil lurking in Xiwutong.

story_structure.climax: During the peak of the Ghost Festival under the Blood Moon, the true nature of the corpse-demons and the hidden history of the An family come to a violent head.
story_structure.conflict: Tragedy strikes the household when Yunman's eldest and second brothers are murdered by mysterious corpse-demons, leading their father, An Bo, to condemn Yunman as a cursed bringer of disaster.
story_structure.resolution: The lingering curse on the family is confronted, forcing the survivors to reckon with the aftermath of the tragedy and Yunman's place in the family's legacy.
story_structure.introduction: An Yunman returns to the An family residence in Xiwutong, western Hunan, just as the Blood Moon hangs overhead and the Ghost Festival approaches.
story_structure.risingAction: Tensions escalate within the family estate as Yunman must navigate her father's severe accusations, impending supernatural threats, and the dark secrets surrounding the killings.
